title: Handmade paper
summary: Dip a wire mould in a vat of rag pulp, slosh it even, couch the sheet onto a woollen felt and squeeze the stack in a screw press.
howToPlay: Press Dip, then drag on the mould to tilt it.
Run the pulp to the thin, pale places before the water drains.
Drag the mould onto the felt and press Couch.
Pump the press when the ball is in the green, then press Check.
rules: The pulp runs towards the side you tilt to.
The water drains through the screen in nine seconds and the fibre stays where it lay: a sheet thick in one place and thin in another scores less.
The form of the sheet counts for 60 points, the couching for 20 and the finish for 20.
Three stars for 88 or more, two stars for 65 and one star for 40. Watch and learn makes a whole sheet for you.
heritageNote: In a Dutch paper mill a sheet is lifted from the vat on a wire mould with a wooden deckle, turned out onto a woollen felt, stacked with its fellows and squeezed in a screw press to drive out the water.
